description:
Tracks a job from jobs_search results in the user's job tracker, identified by its job_id. For a
job found elsewhere on the open web (with a URL but no jobs_search job_id), tracker_add_external
is the right tool instead.

Fields:
- `job_id`: the job ID from jobs_search results (required)
- `status`: initial status (saved, applied, interviewing, offered, archived); defaults to "saved"
- `sub_status`: sub-status within the main status: saved: interested, researching_company, preparing_application, ready_to_apply; applied: application_submitted, followed_up; interviewing: interview_scheduled, phone_screen, technical, onsite, final_round, pending_feedback; offered: negotiating, considering, offer_received, accepted; archived: ghosted, rejected_by_company, withdrawn_by_candidate, not_interested, employed_by_this_company, employed_by_another_company
- `notes`: notes about the job

Returns the tracked job with its details. Repeated saves return the existing tracked job. A job
that was previously removed from the tracker is restored with its earlier status and notes.

job_id.description: The job ID from jobs.search results

result_item_id.description: The result occurrence ID returned with the selected job

status.description: Initial tracking status: saved, applied, interviewing, offered, archived

sub_status.description: Sub-status within the main status, valid only for that status — saved: interested, researching_company, preparing_application, ready_to_apply; applied: application_submitted, followed_up; interviewing: interview_scheduled, phone_screen, technical, onsite, final_round, pending_feedback; offered: negotiating, considering, offer_received, accepted; archived: ghosted, rejected_by_company, withdrawn_by_candidate, not_interested, employed_by_this_company, employed_by_another_company

name: tracker_add

appliedDateUnknown.description: True for a job at the applied status with no stored applied date, unless the person said they do not remember it. FoundRole never fills that date in by itself; it comes from the person and tracker_update stores it in applied_at, or records in applied_date_declined that they do not remember it.

daysSinceApplied.description: Whole days since the applied date, counted in the user's time zone; null without an applied date.

followUpDay.description: Latest follow-up point, in days after applying, that a job still at the applied status has reached; null before the first point and for every other status. FoundRole never moves or archives a job by itself.
